bio.text: Bob Onder was elected in 2024 to represent Missouri's 3rd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and was sworn into the 119th Congress on January 3, 2025.

He is a physician and attorney, holding an M.D. from Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis and a J.D. from Saint Louis University Law School, and ran a private allergy, asthma and clinical immunology practice for over 30 years.
He was elected to the Missouri House in 2006 and the Missouri Senate in 2014, serving two Senate terms before being term-limited in 2022.
